CustomField.label: Risk Score
CustomField.description: First-year risk score (0 or more), recalculated nightly by SCH – Score First Year Students from attendance and simulated classroom activity, using the Risk Score Setting weights. 6 or more alerts the assigned advisor. Origin: SCA-4 / SCA-9.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Nightly first-year risk score. 6 or more means the student needs a check-in.
